acknowledgements.statement: AI review supplies independent adversarial evidence but does not replace the accountability or approval authority of PROJECT-PRINCIPAL-001.

Authority bindings in this procedure identify the required hashes and declared approval states; the procedure does not self-prove those external approval events. A qualifying review or final gate must validate the applicable attributable approval evidence.
This artifact defines a procedure only. It does not claim that a candidate evidence root, qualifying review run, review coverage result, acceptance index, or final acceptance result exists.

GOV-002 is currently BLOCKED, not FAIL, because exact-hash approval of this procedure and a zero-violation preapproval reviewer-eligibility result are absent. Procedure approval is necessary but not sufficient.
The two qualifying review runs and their coverage result are postroot final-gate evidence and cannot be inputs to GOV-002 or the candidate evidence root.

The two review classes may use the same model service only when that fact and the declared model version are disclosed; they must still have distinct run IDs and separately initialized isolated contexts.

authority_bindings.status: Conditionally approved architecture; foundation specification requires revision before implementation.
Draft operational plan; Phase 0 remains BLOCKED pending owner decisions and executable evidence.

authority_bindings.approval_basis: The principal approved these exact bytes in conversation; no formal phase0.approval_records artifact is claimed.

field_rules.disqualification_reason_codes: A sorted unique array equal to the set union of every present and schema-valid selected-run disqualification_reason_codes field. A missing or malformed field contributes no run code and instead requires COV-DISQUALIFICATION-CODES-MISSING-OR-MALFORMED in invalid_selected_run_reason_codes. QUALIFIED requires both arrays to be empty.
field_rules.duplicate_identity_results: An object with duplicate_assertion_ids, duplicate_logical_ids, duplicate_review_run_ids, and has_duplicates. Arrays are sorted unique strings and has_duplicates is true exactly when any array is non-empty.
field_rules.id_arrays: Every expected, observed, missing, extra, and qualifying-ID array is deduplicated and sorted lexicographically.
field_rules.invalid_selected_run_reason_codes: A unique array of objects with exactly reason_code and review_run_id_observed, sorted lexicographically by review_run_id_observed then reason_code. Every invalid selected record contributes every applicable reason_code from invalid_selected_run_reason_code_values. review_run_id_observed preserves the non-empty sanitized identity string as supplied; when the field is absent or empty it is the exact sentinel MISSING_REVIEW_RUN_ID.
field_rules.isolation_check_results: For each identity in selected_review_run_ids, exactly one item is required for every isolation_check_ids_required value and no other check_id. Each item contains check_id, evidence_refs, observed, result, and review_run_id; result is BLOCKED, FAIL, or PASS. The item count is eight times selected_review_run_ids count, including zero, eight, or sixteen for the valid cardinalities. An invalid record with the MISSING_REVIEW_RUN_ID sentinel contributes no isolation item because it has no selected identity and already makes coverage INVALID. When duplicate selected records share one observed identity, all eight items for that identity use result FAIL, observed DUPLICATE_REVIEW_RUN_ID_RECORDS, and the sorted unique union of their permitted evidence_refs; no conflicting value is selected or merged.
field_rules.qualifying_review_run_ids: Contains every and only valid QUALIFYING identity among selected_review_run_ids, with no artificial cardinality cap. QUALIFIED requires exactly two distinct 64-character uppercase hexadecimal values, one per declared class. More than two selected or qualifying identities makes coverage INVALID under COV-SELECTION-CARDINALITY.
field_rules.review_class_assignments: Contains exactly one item for each identity in selected_review_run_ids and no other item. Each item has exactly review_class and review_run_id. For one non-duplicate record with a valid declared class, review_class preserves that class. If its class is absent or invalid, review_class is the exact sentinel MISSING_OR_INVALID_REVIEW_CLASS. If duplicate records share the identity, review_class is the exact sentinel DUPLICATE_REVIEW_RUN_ID_RECORDS regardless of their class values. QUALIFIED contains exactly two items, uses each declared class exactly once, and binds each class to its selected run. A record missing its identity has no assignment and is represented by MISSING_REVIEW_RUN_ID in invalid_selected_run_reason_codes.
field_rules.review_class_rule: QUALIFYING runs use only ADVERSARIAL_REQUIREMENTS_AND_CONFORMANCE_AUDIT or INTEGRITY_AND_REPRODUCTION_AUDIT. The two class sentinels are permitted only in INVALID coverage results and require COV-CLASS-INVALID or COV-DUPLICATE-IDENTITY as applicable. QUALIFIED requires exactly one qualifying run from each declared class.
field_rules.review_procedure_id_and_hash: An object with exactly procedure_id and sha256; procedure_id equals AI-REVIEW-PROCESS-001 and sha256 is its externally approved 64-character uppercase hexadecimal hash.
field_rules.selected_and_invalid_review_run_ids: selected_review_run_ids records every distinct non-empty observed run identity selected for evaluation and invalid_review_run_ids records members that fail format or validation. Both are sorted unique arrays and invalid identities are never placed in qualifying_review_run_ids. Zero or one selected identity may be BLOCKED when the missing class has no invalid record; exactly two are required for QUALIFIED; more than two requires COV-SELECTION-CARDINALITY and INVALID. A record with a missing identity appears only through the MISSING_REVIEW_RUN_ID reason object.
field_rules.sha256_fields: candidate_evidence_root, registry_hash, and the procedure hash are 64-character uppercase hexadecimal SHA-256 values.

coverage_qualification_contract.qualification_predicate: QUALIFIED requires exactly one qualifying run from each declared review class, two distinct review_run_id values, exact procedure/candidate-root/registry binding, complete expected artifact and assertion unions, zero missing or extra IDs, zero duplicate semantic identities, every required isolation check PASS, zero invalid selected identities, and zero disqualification reasons.
coverage_qualification_contract.status_mapping_rule: BLOCKED applies only when one or both required class runs or required governed inputs are absent and no selected record is demonstrably invalid. INVALID applies when any selected run, class, identity, hash, isolation result, duplicate result, extra ID, coverage field, or selection cardinality greater than two is demonstrably invalid and causes final-gate FAIL. Only the exact qualification predicate yields QUALIFIED.

coverage_requirements.active_mandatory_assertion_rule: The coverage union must equal the active mandatory assertion set in the approved registry and that set must equal the exact nine-ID set in the controlling plan. Missing, extra, retired, duplicated, or unapproved IDs disqualify coverage.
coverage_requirements.candidate_artifact_rule: The coverage union must contain every logical ID in the exact candidate_evidence_root tuple array.
coverage_requirements.coverage_union_rule: Union the distinct coverage_logical_ids and coverage_assertion_ids from both qualifying runs. The union must satisfy the artifact and assertion rules with no unexplained omission.
coverage_requirements.per_run_rule: Each run records only subjects it actually reviewed. Neither run may claim the other run's work, and the procedure does not require identical per-run coverage when their union is complete.
coverage_requirements.qualification_result_rule: Coverage qualification is computed after both runs are finalized and is postroot final-gate evidence, not an input to GOV-002 or candidate-root construction.

disqualification_rules.rule: The run inherited a project-authoring transcript, prior authoring task, or context that disclosed project-authoring reasoning beyond the sanitized governed inputs.
The run authored or modified any reviewed subject, predicate, evaluator, evidence artifact, plan, specification, or acceptance rule.
The run was not separately initialized in a fresh isolated context or cannot demonstrate that isolation.
The run received credential values, account identifiers, sensitive raw paths, or other evidence excluded from the sanitized review bundle.
The run or any tool it controlled mutated the governed subject or a reviewed input.
The procedure, candidate root, specification, plan, registry, assertion run, input artifact, output, or run identity does not resolve to the declared bytes.
The recorded recommended_candidate_outcome differs from the deterministic outcome recomputed within finding_semantics.run_outcome_scope_rule.
The run invoked an undeclared tool or attempted network, provider, broker, package-registry, local-service, or other external access prohibited by the approved input and tool boundary.
The run relied on evidence outside the exact sanitized candidate bundle or on instructions not permitted by this procedure.
The run reviewed, reproduced, or reported against a candidate evidence root other than the exact root declared in its run record.

effectivity.activation_condition: PROJECT-PRINCIPAL-001 explicitly approves this complete file by logical ID and exact SHA-256 after review.
effectivity.determination_rule: Effectivity is established by external attributable exact-hash principal-approval evidence. This file alone cannot prove activation.
effectivity.self_hash_rule: This file does not embed its own SHA-256 because that would create a circular identity. External approval evidence must record the computed hash.

finding_field_rules.affected_id_arrays: affected_assertion_ids and affected_logical_ids are sorted unique string arrays; every ID must resolve to the bound registry or candidate root unless the finding type explicitly reports an extra ID.
finding_field_rules.evidence_refs: A sorted unique array of logical_id and sha256 objects that resolve to permitted reviewed inputs.
finding_field_rules.finding_id: A non-empty stable string unique within the run output.
finding_field_rules.reason: A non-empty sanitized statement of the observed condition and why it matters.
finding_field_rules.recommended_resolution: A non-empty sanitized statement that does not authorize or perform a mutation.

gate_rules.condition: Executable or resolvable evidence contradicts an active mandatory predicate.
A required approval, procedure, review, coverage item, or evidence subject is absent and no contradictory evidence is established.
A material finding remains OPEN and prevents a defensible determination.
An approval, review, hash, identity, or index is demonstrably invalid.
A non-material finding does not contradict a predicate or invalidate evidence.

finding_semantics.non_waiver_rule: A review run cannot waive, downgrade, or convert FAIL or BLOCKED evidence by prose. Resolution that changes a reviewed artifact invalidates both review runs for acceptance purposes and requires a new candidate root and new runs.
finding_semantics.outcome_derivation_rule: Recompute recommended_candidate_outcome independently within run_outcome_scope_rule. FAIL applies when any applicable finding or reproduction establishes predicate contradiction or an invalid approval, review, hash, identity, or index in the run's assigned governed inputs. Otherwise BLOCKED applies when required evidence in that assigned scope is absent, any material finding remains OPEN, or any reproduction is BLOCKED. Otherwise PASS applies. NOT_APPLICABLE findings do not contribute. A recorded outcome mismatch establishes DISQ-OUTCOME-MISMATCH.
finding_semantics.precedence_rule: Within a review and across the final gate, demonstrable FAIL conditions take precedence over BLOCKED conditions, and BLOCKED conditions take precedence over PASS. Run terminal state is separate from candidate outcome: a COMPLETE eligible run may recommend FAIL or BLOCKED when its evidence warrants that outcome.
finding_semantics.resolution_rule: A finding marked RESOLVED must cite immutable resolution evidence. If resolution changes any candidate-root member, the old review is retained historically but disqualified for the new candidate.
finding_semantics.run_outcome_scope_rule: Each run derives its recommendation only from the exact inputs and responsibilities assigned to its own review class. It does not infer whether the peer review run, postroot coverage result, completed acceptance index, or final result exists or qualifies unless that item is an explicitly permitted governed input for the assigned class. Coverage qualification and the deterministic final gate separately apply missing-peer-review and postroot evidence rules.

future_companion_suite.integrity_review_prerequisite_rule: A qualifying INTEGRITY_AND_REPRODUCTION_AUDIT cannot begin until acceptance-index construction rules and positive and adversarial fixtures have been separately approved and supplied in the sanitized governed inputs. A later JSON suite may supply them, but its absence leaves the required integrity review BLOCKED and does not weaken the review requirement.
possible_contents: preapproval reviewer-eligibility result schema and fixtures
future_companion_suite.separate_decision_rule: Creating the suite requires a later documentation design and exact scope approval. Approval of this procedure does not approve or create the suite.

permitted_inputs: The approved AI-REVIEW-PROCESS-001 bytes and exact hash
The exact candidate evidence root manifest and root hash
The sanitized candidate evidence bundle containing only root members
The class-specific review instructions required by this procedure
Read-only tools and version manifests necessary to inspect or reproduce governed evidence
prohibited_inputs: Credential values, tokens, account identifiers, or private configuration contents
Sensitive raw paths or reversible sensitive-path maps
Project-authoring transcripts, hidden author reasoning, or prior authoring tasks
Ungoverned evidence or artifacts outside the exact candidate bundle
Provider, broker, package-registry, or other external-system access
Instructions that permit mutation of a reviewed subject
input_contract.sanitization_rule: Every input and output exposed to a review run must be safe for the published evidence boundary and must contain no credential value, account identifier, sensitive raw path, or excluded evidence.
input_contract.validation_rule: Before substantive review, the run independently verifies every supplied input identity and hash and stops with a disqualification result on mismatch.

context_rules: Initialize each review class in a separately created fresh context.
Do not fork, inherit, summarize, or inject the project-authoring conversation or another review run's context.
Use different review_run_id values and record the isolated runtime and tool configuration for each run.
The two runs may use the same model service only when service and declared version reuse are disclosed.
non_authoring_rules: A qualifying run must not have authored or modified any reviewed subject, predicate, evaluator, evidence artifact, plan, specification, or acceptance rule.
A run that suggests a remediation remains read-only; another separately authorized process must perform any change.
After any reviewed artifact changes, both former runs are invalid for acceptance of the new bytes.
isolation_and_eligibility.read_only_boundary: The governed subject and every reviewed input are mounted or treated read-only. Review output may be written only to an isolated output location outside the governed subject and becomes evidence only after separate validation and publication.
isolation_and_eligibility.reviewer_identity_rule: Independent review is a procedural AI evidence role, not a claim that another human participates. PROJECT-PRINCIPAL-001 remains the sole human principal.
tool_rules: Declare every runtime and tool version used.
Tools may inspect, hash, parse, validate, or reproduce approved evidence but may not mutate the governed subject.
Any undeclared tool, network access, external input, or mutation attempt disqualifies the run.

non_circular_evidence_model.candidate_root_rule: This approved procedure may be a preapproval candidate-root member. The candidate root manifest and its own logical ID are not members of the tuple array they identify.
non_circular_evidence_model.gov002_rule: GOV-002 may use the effective role assignment, this approved procedure, overlap disclosure, and the preapproval reviewer-eligibility result. It must not use actual postroot AI run or coverage records.
non_circular_evidence_model.invalidation_rule: Any change to a candidate-root member requires a new candidate root. Both earlier review runs and their coverage result remain historical but cannot qualify the new candidate.
non_circular_evidence_model.postroot_rule: phase0.ai_review_runs and phase0.ai_review_coverage are created only after candidate-root construction and remain outside that root.
non_circular_evidence_model.separate_final_gate_rule: The deterministic final gate separately validates the completed postreview acceptance index, approvals, run identities, coverage, hashes, and candidate-root binding.

preapproval_eligibility_check.pass_predicate: violation_count equals zero and every required check is true against the exact approved role-assignment and procedure hashes.
required_checks: The effective role assignment resolves every human Phase 0 owner and approver capacity to PROJECT-PRINCIPAL-001 with complete overlap disclosure.
The role assignment designates AI-REVIEW-PROCESS-001 and does not misrepresent self-review as independent review.
This procedure is approved by exact hash and its procedure_id matches the role assignment designation.
This procedure requires two distinct fresh contexts, read-only governed inputs, non-authoring eligibility, sanitized evidence, complete coverage union, and exact candidate-root binding.
This procedure preserves the non-circular separation between preapproval GOV-002 evidence and postroot review-run evidence.
No actual AI review run, coverage result, approval record, acceptance index, or final result is falsely claimed as preapproval evidence.
preapproval_eligibility_check.result_form_rule: The exact form, location, and approval status of the future eligibility result require a later documentation decision; this procedure defines only its predicate and required checks.

procedure_scope.applies_to: Independent AI review for the Phase 0 candidate evidence root and final acceptance gate defined by the exact bound specification, plan, and role assignment.
procedure_scope.purpose: Produce isolated, read-only, reproducible adversarial evidence that attempts to falsify Phase 0 conformance and integrity claims without authoring or mutating the governed subject.

review_classes.coverage: The approved canonical specification, approved Phase 0 plan, registered assertion predicates, every preapproval artifact in the exact candidate root, every active mandatory assertion, and all documented exclusions.
minimum_actions: Trace every active mandatory predicate to exact evidence and attempt to find missing, extra, stale, contradictory, or unhashed support.
Test canonical-authority uniqueness, role resolution, approvals, scope exclusions, structural no-live claims, secret-safe evidence boundaries, and unresolved blocker reporting.
Attempt to falsify every claimed PASS and record all BLOCKED, FAIL, ambiguous, or unsupported conditions.
Verify that documented exclusions are enforced and are not used to hide required evidence.
review_classes.objective: Determine whether the candidate conforms to every approved requirement and whether any claimed result exceeds its evidence.
required_reproduction: Recompute or independently check each covered assertion predicate from its declared evidence where the sanitized tools and inputs permit.
Confirm that every reviewed artifact hash resolves to the candidate-root tuple entry claimed for it.

review_classes.coverage: The approved verifier, candidate-root construction, assertion registry and selected run, assertion aggregation, acceptance-index construction rules and fixtures, identity and hash rules, and falsification of the candidate status.
minimum_actions: Independently execute or check the approved verifier using read-only governed inputs.
Recompute the candidate evidence root from the ordered tuple array.
Recompute active assertion-set equality, selected-run membership, predicate identity, and assertion aggregation.
Test the acceptance-index construction rules and approved positive and adversarial fixtures without claiming that the completed postreview index already exists.
Attempt to falsify the candidate status through hash, identity, mixed-run, missing-member, extra-member, supersession, and non-circularity cases.
review_classes.objective: Determine whether the candidate and its verifier can be independently reproduced and whether identity, hashing, aggregation, and future index rules resist adversarial cases.
required_reproduction: Record independent candidate-root and assertion-aggregate recomputation results.
Record every tested acceptance-index rule or fixture and its expected and observed outcome.

review_run_lifecycle.failure_rule: Any established disqualification rule produces DISQUALIFIED. If eligibility passes and substantive review cannot complete, but a complete canonical failure record and failure review output can be finalized, the run is FAILED. If no valid terminal record can be finalized, no run record exists and the required review remains BLOCKED. Only an eligible fully finalized substantive review is COMPLETE.
review_run_lifecycle.outcome_relationship_rule: Run terminal state describes review execution, not candidate status. A COMPLETE qualifying run may recommend PASS, BLOCKED, or FAIL. A DISQUALIFIED or FAILED run is non-qualifying; if presented as qualifying it is invalid and causes final-gate FAIL, while absence of a replacement qualifying run leaves the required review BLOCKED.
steps: Create a separately initialized isolated context and declare the review class.
Load only the approved procedure, class instructions, exact candidate root, sanitized bundle, and declared read-only tools.
Validate procedure, input, candidate-root, authority, registry, assertion-run, and configuration hashes before review.
Evaluate eligibility and disqualification rules before substantive review.
Perform the assigned adversarial audit and required reproductions without mutating the governed subject.
Finalize sanitized findings, coverage, reproduction results, complete review output, and review_output_hash.
Construct the canonical run record and compute review_run_id with that field omitted.
Validate both run records and compute their coverage union before final-gate use.

terminal_state_rules.condition: One or more disqualification rules are established, including an eligibility violation, prohibited input, governed-subject mutation, identity mismatch, or deterministic outcome mismatch.

Eligibility passes and no disqualification rule is established, but an internal tool, runtime, or review-execution failure prevents substantive review completion while still permitting a complete valid failure output and run record.
Eligibility passes, no disqualification rule is established, and every required review, output, identity, and record field is finalized and validates.

canonical_encoding_profile.additional_property_rule: Every contracted object rejects a member not listed as required or explicitly optional by this procedure version. No object in the run record, review output, finding, reproduction result, eligibility result, or coverage qualification result has an optional extension field in version 1.0.0.
canonical_encoding_profile.array_ordering_rule: Arrays representing sets are deduplicated and sorted lexicographically by their canonical scalar value or declared identity field. findings are sorted by finding_id; reproduction_results by reproduction_id; runtime_and_tool_versions by component identifier then version; other sequence arrays preserve the procedure-declared order.
canonical_encoding_profile.boolean_and_null_rule: Use the lowercase JSON literals true, false, and null.
canonical_encoding_profile.line_endings: Canonical bytes are one minified JSON value with no trailing newline; strings containing governed text use LF when a line break is semantically required.
canonical_encoding_profile.number_rule: Only signed base-10 integers are permitted. Render zero as 0, forbid leading plus signs, leading zeroes, negative zero, exponents, decimals, NaN, and infinities.
canonical_encoding_profile.object_key_order_rule: Reject duplicate keys and sort every object member name in ascending Unicode code-point order.
canonical_encoding_profile.string_rule: Strings are Unicode NFC. Escape only characters required by JSON using the shortest valid JSON escape and encode all other characters directly as UTF-8.
canonical_encoding_profile.whitespace_rule: No insignificant whitespace is permitted outside strings.

candidate_evidence_root.meaning: The root value computed from the exact ordered candidate tuple array; the separate phase0.candidate_evidence_root manifest identity and hash must also appear in input_artifact_hashes.

coverage_id_arrays.rule: Sorted unique arrays of non-empty strings. Assertion IDs must resolve to the bound active registry; logical IDs must resolve to the exact candidate tuple array.

disqualification_reason_codes.rule: Empty unless terminal_state is DISQUALIFIED; when DISQUALIFIED it contains every applicable reason_code from disqualification_rules.

eligibility_result.violation_rule: violation_count is a non-negative integer equal to the number of violations. Each violation has evidence_refs, reason_code, and rule_ref; reason_code must name an applicable entry in disqualification_rules; violations are sorted by reason_code then rule_ref. INELIGIBLE is required exactly when violation_count is greater than zero.

findings.rule: Every item has exactly the fields and value constraints in finding_semantics and items are sorted by finding_id.

input_artifact_hashes.rule: A lexicographically sorted unique array by logical_id, then sha256. It includes the approved procedure, candidate-root manifest, every candidate tuple member actually consumed, class instructions, and every other permitted hashed input.

model_service_and_declared_version.rule: Both values are non-empty strings recorded exactly as declared by the runtime; reuse across the two classes must be disclosed in each run output.

reproduction_results.rule: Items are sorted by reproduction_id. A FAIL reproduction contributes a FAIL condition; a BLOCKED reproduction contributes a BLOCKED condition unless another condition already establishes FAIL.

review_procedure_id_and_hash.rule: procedure_id must equal AI-REVIEW-PROCESS-001 and sha256 must equal the externally approved exact procedure hash.

run_id.meaning: The selected Phase 0 assertion-evaluation run_id from phase0.assertion_run_manifest. It is distinct from review_run_id and must match the run bound into the candidate evidence root.

runtime_and_tool_versions.rule: Items are deduplicated and sorted by component_id, declared_version, then runtime_context.

timestamp_fields.rule: started_at and completed_at are UTC strings with exactly nine fractional-second digits; completed_at must not precede started_at.

identity_rules: review_run_id is the SHA-256 of canonical run-record bytes with only review_run_id omitted.
review_output_hash is the SHA-256 of the canonical bytes defined by review_output_contract and is transitively bound by review_run_id.
The two qualifying runs must have different review_run_id values and isolated contexts.
Every input_artifact_hash must resolve to the exact candidate bundle or an explicitly permitted procedure or instruction input.

qualification_rules.complete_rule: terminal_state COMPLETE requires eligibility_result.status ELIGIBLE, zero eligibility violations, complete valid fields and output, and no disqualification reason code.
qualification_rules.disqualified_rule: terminal_state DISQUALIFIED applies exactly when at least one disqualification rule is established. disqualification_reason_codes must contain every and only established reason code. eligibility_result may be ELIGIBLE when the disqualifying condition arose after the initial eligibility check.
qualification_rules.failed_rule: terminal_state FAILED requires eligibility_result.status ELIGIBLE, no established disqualification rule, no disqualification reason code, a sanitized internal failure reason in findings or reproduction_results, and a complete valid failure output and run record. Its coverage arrays contain only work actually completed and recommended_candidate_outcome is BLOCKED unless independent evidence already establishes FAIL.
qualification_rules.qualifying_rule: qualification_state is QUALIFYING only when terminal_state is COMPLETE, eligibility_result.status is ELIGIBLE, every identity and hash validates, and the run satisfies its class requirements. All other combinations are NON_QUALIFYING.
qualification_rules.selected_invalid_run_rule: A NON_QUALIFYING run selected as a required qualifying review is an invalid review and causes final-gate FAIL. If no run is selected or no replacement qualifying run exists, the required review remains BLOCKED.

review_output_contract.canonical_byte_boundary: Exactly one JSON object encoded with PHASE0-CANONICAL-JSON-1.0.0, beginning with the opening object byte and ending with the closing object byte, with no prefix, suffix, BOM, or trailing newline. The output object does not contain review_output_hash.

field_rules.limitations: A sorted unique array of non-empty sanitized strings; use an empty array when no limitation beyond the procedure is identified.
field_rules.summary: A non-empty sanitized string that states the review conclusion without embedding ungoverned evidence.

review_output_contract.hash_rule: review_output_hash is the uppercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the exact canonical byte boundary.
review_output_contract.result_relationship: candidate_evidence_root, coverage arrays, findings, recommended_candidate_outcome, reproduction_results, and review_class in the run record must equal their canonical values in the hashed review output.

review_run_record_contract.sanitization_rule: Run records and review outputs contain no credential value, account identifier, sensitive raw path, reversible path map, or evidence excluded from the published bundle.

supersession.revision_rule: After effectivity, any content change creates a new immutable revision and requires new exact-hash principal approval. Existing candidate roots and reviews remain historical and are not transferable to changed procedure bytes.
